title: Jury duty “failure to appear”
scenario: A caller says you failed to appear for jury duty and must pay a civil fine before a judge reviews the case. They know your address and local courthouse name.

answers.A: Ask for the case number and judge name, then verify them independently.
answers.B: Pay if the caller accepts a normal credit card and provides a receipt rather than gift cards or crypto.
answers.C: Hang up and contact the court using its official website or published clerk number.

explanation: Professional payment methods do not authenticate a government demand. The court itself can confirm whether the case exists.
proTip: Normal payment method, abnormal process: still verify.
